name: InitCollider
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x03: runs the placed-object set-up func_00123ED0, clears the mesh at 0x380 and copies it to 0x3A4, sets 0x4BC and 0x4C0 to -1, copies the world's gravity into 0x350 and picks the handler with func_001BB4A0

name: RegisterCollider
evidence: slot 6 of class 0x03: counts itself in the world (+0x34), as a parentless body takes a contact table (func_001DC7D0) and joins the world's body list, then runs func_001240F8 and recomputes the body flags

name: UnregisterCollider
evidence: slot 7 of class 0x03: the reverse of slot 6: leaves the body's parts list, uncounts itself, gives back its contact table and the touched-object list (func_001DC108), then runs func_001243E0

name: SetColliderPartListed
evidence: stores flag in bit 50 of the flags at +0x538 and adds the collider to (flag 1) or removes it from (flag 0) the part list at +0x2D8 of its root with func_00152470 / func_00152600, then tells the world (func_00138BE0 with 7) and the root's slot 32; RegisterCollider calls it with 1 and UnregisterCollider with 0

name: ApplyColliderPendingMove
evidence: slot 47 of class 0x03: adds the pending vector at 0x490 to the position at 0x100 and turns the matrix by the pending rotation at 0x4A0, clears them, then calls slot 47 of the parts and slot 18

name: ApplyColliderPendingImpulse
evidence: slot 48 of class 0x03: adds the pending vectors at 0x490 and 0x4A0 into the vectors at 0x150 and 0x160, clears them and calls slot 48 of the parts

name: ApplyColliderPendingImpulseHalfStep
evidence: slot 49 of class 0x03: like slot 48 but also adds the pending vector times half the step D_00261860 to the position and turns the matrix by half the pending rotation, then calls slot 49 of the parts

name: ExpandColliderBoundsBySphere
evidence: widens the bounds box (0x420, 0x430) and the two radii about the position 0x140 (0x3D0) and the centre 0x3E0 (0x3D4) to take in a sphere of the given radius at a point; UpdatePlayerBounds and UpdatePathFollowerBounds call it for their extra points

name: UpdateColliderBounds
evidence: slot 50 of class 0x03: walks the body's parts and stores the minimum and maximum corner (0x420, 0x430), centre (0x3E0) and radii (0x3D0, 0x3D4) of their positions and mesh vertices

name: TransformMeshToWorld
evidence: copies a mesh's vertices (count +4, array +8) and its faces (count +0xC, array +0x10, 0x20 bytes each) through a matrix and an offset into a second mesh, recomputing each face's plane distance from its first vertex (+0x1E); ComputeColliderWorldFrame and ComputeCountedColliderWorldFrame call it

name: ComputeColliderWorldFrame
evidence: slot 19 of class 0x03: runs func_00125138, then transforms mesh and mesh2 into their copies at 0x3A4 and 0x50C with the world position (0x140) and matrix (0x110) through func_001B8820

name: RecomputeColliderFrame
evidence: slot 18 of class 0x03: runs func_00125108, tells the body's slot 50 that its parts changed and queues the object in the world (func_00138BE0 with 7)

name: TestCollidersMayContact
evidence: slot 56 of class 0x03: returns 1 when the first object has flag bit 47 or 55 and the second has bit 55, otherwise 0

name: NotifyContactHandlers
evidence: slot 67 of class 0x03: for each contact in the body's table whose timer exceeds 0.0001 calls slot 65 of both ends' handler (func_001BB540) and zeroes the timer

name: ComputeSegmentParameter
evidence: returns the parameter of a point's projection on the segment between two points: the dot product of (p - a) and (b - a) over the squared length of (b - a); func_001B8B90 calls it

name: AddContactVertexBlendVelocity
evidence: slot 0xFC of class 0x03: for a collider whose hook holds per-vertex vectors, finds the vertex, edge or face the contact touched, weights its vertices by the contact point and adds their blended vector, rotated into the world, to the end's velocity at +0x30

name: ApplyColliderInverseInertia
evidence: turns a vector into the body's frame (the matrix at 0x110), multiplies it by the inverse inertia at 0x320 and turns it back; StepPathFollower and func_001BC828 use it

name: SteerColliderTowardPosition
evidence: adds to the force accumulator (AddColliderForce) a pull toward a target position (from 0x100) and toward a target velocity (from 0x150), each scaled by its three-gain table of the distance, the velocity term limited to one over the frame time; the step functions of the player, agents and stand-ins call it

name: SteerColliderTowardRotation
evidence: the rotation counterpart of SteerColliderTowardPosition: turns the difference to a target matrix into an axis and angle (MatrixToAxisAngle) and the difference to a target spin (0x160) into a torque by their gain tables, added with AddColliderTorque

name: StepCollider
evidence: slot 28 of class 0x03: for a parentless body without flag bit 36 applies gravity (func_001BA500, func_001B9AB0), then calls slot 51 of each owner in the attachment list with the frame time

name: DrawCollider
evidence: slot 37 of class 0x03 (the draw slot): only runs class 0x02's func_001261C0 with its two arguments; DrawTimedGroup and others call it as their base

name: UpdateCollider
evidence: slot 17 of the 0x03 class: only runs UpdatePlacedObject (func_00124FC0)

name: SetColliderMass
evidence: rescales the mass (0x368) to the given value and recomputes with func_001B9448 (LoadCollider calls func_001B9448 with 1.0 after reading the mass)

name: ComputeColliderInverseInertia
evidence: scales the inertia rows at 0x2F0 by the mass and inverts them (InvertMatrix3x3) into 0x320, clearing it when singular; SetColliderMass and LoadCollider call it

name: DropColliderContacts
evidence: removes from the contact rows of the root every contact whose end is a part under this object (mode 1), exactly this part (mode 2) or of kind 8..9 on end 0 (mode 3), and hands them to func_001861E8

name: SaveColliderPreviousPosition
evidence: slot 68 of class 0x03: copies the vector at 0x140 to 0x370 (SetColliderPosition calls it for every part)

name: SetColliderPosition
evidence: slot 29 of class 0x03: stores the vector at 0x100 (resetting the tracker D_00261990 if a flagged body jumps more than 10 units), recomputes, updates the contacts, calls slot 68 of the parts and slot 14 with kind 3

name: SetColliderRotation
evidence: slot 30 of class 0x03: copies the three matrix rows to 0x0D0, runs slot 18 when it has a root, updates the contacts (func_001B94F0) and calls slot 14 with kind 4

name: PlaceColliderClearOfContacts
evidence: sets the position (slot 29) and refreshes the world (func_00138C00) up to ten times, moving the position on by the given offset while one of the body's contacts is deeper than 2 (+0x90 below -2); SetObjectGathererSuspended and PlaceAtArrivalPoint call it

name: SetColliderVelocity
evidence: slot 32 of class 0x03: calls func_001274F8 and, when the new vector at 0x150 differs from the old by 2.0 or more on an axis, queues the object in the world (func_00138BE0 with 2)

name: SetColliderSpin
evidence: slot 33 of class 0x03: calls func_00127590 and, when the new vector at 0x160 differs from the old by 0.02 or more on an axis, queues the object in the world (func_00138BE0 with 2)

name: AddColliderForce
evidence: adds a vector to the force accumulator at 0x170; StepCollider adds gravity with it and the step functions their pulls

name: AddColliderTorque
evidence: adds a vector to the torque accumulator at 0x180; SteerColliderTowardRotation, func_001B9D10 and SyncPlayerTarget use it

name: SetColliderAnchors
evidence: stores the modes at 0x450 and 0x470 and (when given) the vectors at 0x440 and 0x460, and refreshes the flags with UpdateAnchorModeFlags when the both-3 test changed

name: ReparentCollider
evidence: slot 21 of class 0x03: converts the anchor vectors at 0x440/0x460 out of the old parent's frame (func_001280C0), calls the base func_001245A8, converts them into the new parent's frame and recomputes the body flags

name: ReframeColliderAnchors
evidence: slot 22 of class 0x03: calls func_00124868 with the other object, then rotates the anchor vectors at 0x440/0x460 by the other's matrix at 0xD0 and sets them with their modes through func_001B9AE0

name: TurnColliderTowardRotation
evidence: turns the body toward a target matrix within a three-value table, limiting the spin and its change with ClampToMagnitude before adding the torque (AddColliderTorque); the step functions of walker colliders, hit targets, gatherers and agents call it

name: CaptureColliderPose
evidence: fills a record with the position 0x140, the vector 0x150, a heading angle from the matrix at 0x110, 100.0 and the current time D_0026185C[0]

name: IsContactBetweenParts
evidence: walks the root's contact rows and returns 1 when one end's part lies under this object and the other end's part under the other object

name: FindContactingPart
evidence: walks the root's contact rows and returns the part at the other end of the first contact whose end lies under this object, else 0

name: CopyCollider
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x03: saves its links, parts list, contact table and handler, calls the placed-object copy func_00127048, restores them and copies the meshes and BSP trees with func_00160EA0 and func_0013E6C8

name: ConstrainVectorByParentAnchor
evidence: ConstrainVectorByAnchor with the anchor's axis first turned by the parent's (+0x18) matrix at 0x110: keeps the vector (mode 0 at +0x10), removes or keeps only its component along the axis (modes 1, 2) or clears it (3), and writes the removed rest when asked

name: ConstrainVectorByAnchor
evidence: by the anchor's mode at +0x10 keeps the vector (0), removes its component along the anchor's axis (1), keeps only that component (2) or clears it (3), and writes the removed rest when given an output; the path-curve searches use it

name: ConstrainColliderVector
evidence: ConstrainVectorByAnchor on one of the body's anchors (0x440, 0x460), the object argument unused; StepCollider and the gauge steps call it

name: AddColliderAttachment
evidence: pushes the attachment node onto the list at 0x4B0 (self->attached, walked by StepCollider) and runs ResetRootTries

name: RemoveColliderAttachment
evidence: unlinks the attachment node from the singly linked list self->attached and runs ResetRootTries

name: ApplyColliderAttachedSetContact
evidence: slot 0x128 of class 0x03: measures the depth of the collider in the attached set (func_001EF5B8), adds the push force along its gravity, steers its position and spin toward the set's surface motion by the drag factor and torques it to the surface normal, then plays or stops the contact sound

name: IgnoreColliderAttachmentStep
evidence: slot 51 of class 0x03 (0xDC, called by what the object is attached to with the frame time): does nothing

name: LoadCollider
evidence: slot 10 of class 0x03: reads the collision prefix from the stream: two meshes, mass, inertia, offset, the group, node-group and face-reference tables, then the common block (func_001289C0)

name: SetColliderOverrideRadius
evidence: sets bit 40 of the flags at 0x538 and stores the radius at 0x3CC

name: ResetColliderAnchors
evidence: runs SetColliderAnchors(self, 3, 0, 3, 0), the anchors SetupSequencedObject also gives

name: GetAnchorPreset
evidence: copies the value and the vector at the index of the 8-entry table D_002746E0 into the two outputs

name: SetColliderTurnAnchorPreset
evidence: script built-in: sets the second anchor (0x460, its mode 0x470) to an entry of the preset table (GetAnchorPreset) with its axis turned into the body's frame (0xD0), keeping the first (SetColliderAnchors)

name: SetColliderMoveAnchorPreset
evidence: script built-in: sets the first anchor (0x440, its mode 0x450) to an entry of the preset table (GetAnchorPreset) with its axis turned into the body's frame (0xD0), keeping the second (SetColliderAnchors)

name: SetColliderFlagNibble32
evidence: stores the low 4 bits of its argument in bits 32 to 35 of the flags at 0x538; no caller

name: SetColliderFlagBit47
evidence: stores the low bit of its argument in bit 47 of the flags at 0x538, the bit TestCollidersMayContact tests (with 55) on the first object; no caller

name: SetColliderFlagBit48
evidence: stores the low bit of its argument in bit 48 of the flags at 0x538; no caller

name: SetColliderSurfaceKind
evidence: stores a byte at +0x2C8, the surface kind CreatePooledContact copies into each contact end

name: SetColliderFlagNibble36
evidence: stores the low 4 bits of its argument in bits 36 to 39 of the flags at 0x538 (InitContactTracker sets them to 2, StepCollider tests bit 36 before applying gravity); a script built-in (func_001016F0) calls it

name: SendColliderNotification
evidence: slot 14 of class 0x03: calls the base func_00183350, then calls slot 13 (kind, arg) of each owner in its attachment list at 0x4B0

name: FindColliderFloorContact
evidence: walks the contact list at +0x480 (optionally only contacts with the given other object) for a contact whose normal (+0x88) points more than 0.7 up for the collider's side, keeps the one with the smallest +0x18 value, stores the side index through the third argument and returns the contact or 0; the agents and player collider call it as a ground test

name: SetColliderGravityDisabled
evidence: stores its flag in bit 51 of the 64-bit flags at 0x538, which StepCollider tests before adding the constrained gravity (+0x350) as a force; a setter in the object property records FillObjectPropertyTable (func_00109488) fills

name: SetColliderTreeContactsDropped
evidence: script built-in: stores bit 42 of the flags at 0x538 and drops the contacts with the parts under the body (DropColliderContacts mode 1) when set; SetPlayerState calls it too

name: SetColliderContactsDropped
evidence: script built-in: stores bit 43 of the flags at 0x538 (the bit the notifier and range filters refuse) and drops the body's own contacts (DropColliderContacts mode 2) when set

name: SetColliderKindContactsDropped
evidence: script built-in: stores bit 44 of the flags at 0x538 and drops the contacts with kinds 8 and 9 (DropColliderContacts mode 3) when set

name: ResolveContactHandler
evidence: sets the handler at 0x4E4 to itself when its descriptor has slot 0x3C, 0x3D, 0x3E or 0x41, else to its parent's handler, and recurses into the children whose class flag bit 1 is set

name: FindHandlerForSlot
evidence: follows the handler links from the node upward and returns the first handler whose descriptor word at the given offset is nonzero (its caller func_001B8A48 passes 0x114)

name: UpdateAnchorModeFlags
evidence: sets flag bit 54 when both modes 0x450 and 0x470 are 3, bit 56 from the parent, bit 55 from all the children and calls func_00138F28 for a rootless parent when bit 55 changed

name: CollectContactingPartsToScriptList
evidence: walks the root's contact rows, and for each contact touching this part appends the other part to the script list unless already present

name: CollectContactingParts
evidence: counts, allocates (func_0018D658) and fills an array of the distinct parts at the other end of the root's contacts whose end lies under this object, returning the count

name: IsInTouchingList
evidence: walks the list of touch nodes and returns 1 when a node's object is the given one

name: UpdateTouchingParts
evidence: triggers script event 6 for parts that newly touch and 7 for ones that stopped, then rebuilds the list at self->touching from the root's contacts

name: RequestColliderLaunch
evidence: slot 71 of class 0x03, the launch request RequestAttachedSetLaunch and RequestContactTrackerLaunch override: offers nothing and returns 0

name: InitColliderMeshMotion
evidence: allocates the hook of a collider without one: per-vertex velocity and acceleration arrays and, per face, the three vertex indices found from its edges and ordered to agree with the face normal; AdvanceColliderMeshMotion moves the vertices by them

name: AdvanceColliderMeshMotion
evidence: moves each vertex of the mesh by its velocity and acceleration over the step, updates the velocity, sets the radius at +0x3CC from the farthest vertex and rebuilds each face's normal and distance from its three vertices; MoveCollider calls it when the hook is set

name: MoveCollider
evidence: slot 0x7C (motion) of class 0x03: runs func_001BBEB8 when the body has a hook, then the base motion func_00125440; MoveModeCollider, MoveContactListObject and SetPlayerBoundsPoints call it

name: ApplyColliderImpulseEvent
evidence: makes a kind 0xC contact at the origin with the direction from the target, stores the speed in it, notifies the contact ends and solves it in the collider's root group (SolveColliderGroupContacts); HandleObjectEvent calls it for an event with flag 8

name: ComputeColliderJumpVelocity
evidence: the launch velocity that carries the body from its position (0x140) to a target over a peak the given height above the higher of the two, under its gravity (0x358), with the flight time from SolveQuadratic; LaunchPlayerFromModeWalker calls it

name: HandleObjectEvent
evidence: slot of class 3: when eventFlags has 8 it calls func_001BC0E0 with the event's radius, and returns whether eventFlags is non-zero; the overrides call it as their base

name: CopyColliderMeshesInFrame
evidence: slot 52 of class 0x03: takes another object's meshes, finds the largest vertex radius, copies them through the relative transform func_00188B08 into its own and copies the BSP trees

name: ExtractContactsByPartMode
evidence: for a root collider walks its contact rows: by the mode at +0x4E0 of the other end's part, mode 1 copies the contact to the output list, mode 3 drops it to a free list, mode 4 moves it to the output list; frees the dropped ones with func_001861E8

name: IsPointInsideCollider
evidence: with the override radius (bit 40 of 0x538, SetColliderOverrideRadius) tests the point's distance from 0x140 against 0x3CC, else tests the tree at 0x3F8 (func_0013E658); ChooseSequencedObjectState calls it

name: SetColliderFlagBit52
evidence: stores the low bit of its argument in bit 52 of the flags at 0x538; GetColliderFlagBit52 reads it back; no caller

name: GetColliderFlagBit52
evidence: writes bit 52 of the flags at 0x538 through its out pointer (SetColliderFlagBit52 sets it); no caller

name: NumberColliderParts
evidence: slot 53 of class 0x03: stores the running index at 0x4C0, writes itself into the list at that index and recurses into the children whose descriptor has flag 2

name: ComputeColliderPointVelocity
evidence: the velocity of a point carried by the body: the linear part of a velocity pair plus its angular part crossed with the point's offset from 0x140; func_001BC978 and the contact solvers use it

name: ComputeColliderImpulseResponse
evidence: slot 57 of class 0x03: for one side of a contact, the change of motion a unit push along its normal gives the body: the push over the mass (0x368) and the turn from ApplyColliderInverseInertia, each held to its anchor (ConstrainVectorByParentAnchor), written to its row (0x4C0) for the parents in turn

name: AddParentVelocityToChildRows
evidence: slot 0xEC of class 0x03: for each part after the first, takes the parent's point velocity (ComputeColliderPointVelocity), constrains it by the part's anchor and adds it, with the angular part and a lever correction from the part's offset and inertia, to the part's impulse row

name: SolveColliderGroupContacts
evidence: the contact solve ProcessColliderGroup hands a group of fewer than 0x40 items: builds an active-set solver over the group's contacts (InitActiveSetSolver, AddActiveSetItem), runs it (RunActiveSetSolver) and applies the results through each part's handler (FindHandlerForSlot) on back memory; func_001BC0E0 calls it too

name: CollectGroupItems
evidence: gathers up to cap items from each root's own item chain (+0x4B4) and from the item chains of its groups' children not already marked with bit 58 of flags538; clears the marks and returns the count

name: CollectConnectedColliders
evidence: breadth-first walk from a collider over its list at +0x480, marking visited ones with bit 57 of flags538; colliders with bit 55 go to the second output list, the rest to the queue; clears the marks of the second list at the end and returns both counts

name: SetColliderForcedState
evidence: with mode set: saves the two mode words (+0x450, +0x470) and flag bits 54 and 55 into +0x90, +0x94 and +0xC0, then forces both modes to 3 and sets both bits; with mode 0 restores them

name: SortCollidersByContactCount
evidence: counting sort (buckets 0..3) of the collider array by how many entries of its list at +0x480 have a nonzero first word, only when bit 55 of flags538 is set; permutes the array in place with func_0018D800

name: ProcessColliderGroup
evidence: gathers items with func_001BD558; when fewer than 0x40 (or n < 2) hands the group to func_001BCD00, otherwise sorts, splits the array in halves, marks one half with bit 58 and recurses on each half, forcing the other half's parts with func_001BD790

name: ProcessColliderGroups
evidence: walks the world's collider list: gathers connected colliders with func_001BD678 for each unmarked one and processes them with func_001BDA50, calling slot 31 on non-settled ones first when flag bit 0 is set; finally clears bit 57 of every body in the second list

name: SwapSortRecords
evidence: swaps two fixed-size records of a byte array (rows rowA and rowB, word by word over stride bytes); only the heap sort func_001BE0A8 calls it

name: HeapSortRecords
evidence: array sort of n records of given size with a compare callback: builds the heap with sift-down loops and swaps the root to the end via func_001BE068
